official_identity_sources.observation: Official China page identifies the 16/25 mm family, HD6011 aluminium-magnesium slats, manual and motorised options, and standard manual 25 mm size limits of W 300-2700 mm and H 300-3000 mm.

Official technical brochure shows the 25 mm family at a generic 1000 mm example width and documents a 24.9 x 25.3 mm standard headrail, 21.6 x 12 mm bottom rail and 25 mm slats. The vector diagrams are family technical evidence, not project-size CAD geometry.
Official flyer confirms the interior Venetian blind family and daylight-control use; it is identity evidence only.
The official filtered download result contains one product with only a Product Flyer PDF and a Technical Brochure PDF. No DWG, DXF or other CAD file is returned.

official_product_cad.reason: No official project-size or exact-SKU DWG is published on the verified manufacturer surfaces. The official 1000 mm technical vector example cannot be scaled or substituted as an 1812 mm project shop drawing.

dimension_cross_check.note: The project Body is consistent with a full-height 25 mm Venetian blind and fits the official standard-manual size envelope. No official source proves this exact object, finish, control type or 1812 x 1596 mm shop geometry, so no fitting or official-blue geometry substitution is permitted.
